title: lepisorus oligolepidus
intro: Lepisorus oligolepidus, commonly known as the Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepisorus oligolepidus are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
